basis_words: Round 126 DB-i-13 series-ended cause read. Saved round-122 Orion bodies (two) carry 9 Account series in total; 2 of them are early-ending, their last series end date strictly before the window end. Opal positions silver was read through the GET-only reader over 117 daily partitions (the ones after the earliest early-ending series end, up to the window end); no vendor call and no write was made. Early-ending account 1: last series end 95 days before the window end; 95 partitions after it, 0 of them hold a positive total, the newest does not hold; verdict CLOSED_OR_TRANSFERRED. Early-ending account 2: last series end 120 days before the window end; 117 partitions after it, 1 of them hold a positive total, the newest does not hold; verdict CLOSED_OR_TRANSFERRED. Verdict counts: STALE_AT_SOURCE 0, CLOSED_OR_TRANSFERRED 2, NOT_DETERMINED 0. For the feed: a STALE_AT_SOURCE account means the feed's SERIES_ENDED_AT_SOURCE rows hide an account Opal still holds after Orion's series ended, so the feed would serve a hole for a live account. A CLOSED_OR_TRANSFERRED account is not held on the newest partition, so the series end is consistent with a close or transfer. NOT_DETERMINED means no partition exists after the series end to test. What this does not establish: a held position after a series end is not proof of a vendor fault, and an absent position is not proof that the account closed.
